summary: All 45 source hashes and sizes matched, and all seven computations reproduced. Figure S2 names three of seven young-hypothalamus DEGs. All three have negative registered effects and raw P < 0.05. None of the 19,186 registered genes passes BH < 0.05. The corrected proposal retains closure for the membership comparison, cites the GEO FTP evidence in place of a reCAPTCHA page, and clarifies cohort age, identifier coverage, and the authors’ reported thresholds. It passed the repository proposal checker.
openIssues: Four Venn members, the full author testing universe, the exact selection rule, and the libraries included in the author fit remain unidentified.
Signed author effects and per-gene P values remain unavailable. The preprint leaves the comparator for its Ifi27l2a expression statement unclear, so author effect concordance remains unassessed.
